== Course of events ==

With the Saw-Horse's leg broken and no trees or materials on hand for a repair, the group had been left stranded, forced to sit and consider what to do next. Nick Chopper, called upon to solve the problem, amputates Jack Pumpkinhead's left leg and fits it onto the Saw-Horse in place of the broken one, restoring the wooden creature's ability to walk.

The repair does not pass without complaint: Jack Pumpkinhead and the Saw-Horse fall to bickering over the exchange, each finding fault with the arrangement now forced upon them. Despite the friction between the two, the fix holds, and the group is able to resume its journey toward the Emerald City.
